brief:
The Labour Muslim Network and International Centre of Justice for Palestinians issued a legal briefing calling on the British government to respond "urgently and comprehensively" to Israeli settlement expansion, according to Middle East Eye. The two organizations published the document to pressure UK officials toward stronger measures on the issue.

The briefing represents an escalation in advocacy by Labour-aligned Muslim organizations and international legal groups seeking to shift British government policy on Palestinian territory. The timing and framing suggest ongoing efforts to mobilize domestic political pressure on the issue within the UK.
dek: UK urged to act 'comprehensively' against Israel's settlement plans The Labour Muslim Network (LMN) and International Centre of Justice for Palestinians (ICJP) have published a legal briefing urging the British government to act "urgently and comprehensively"…
title: Muslim groups urge UK to take comprehensive action against Israeli settlements
